targets.query: from(bucket: "${bucket}") |> range(start: -20m) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "telemetry_raw" and r.variable == "PotenciaMW" and r._field == "value") |> last()
from(bucket: "${bucket}") |> range(start: -20m) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "telemetry_raw" and r.variable == "PotenciaMW" and r._field == "value")

from(bucket: "${bucket}") |> range(start: -6h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "anomaly_event") |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value") |> keep(columns: ["_time", "equipment", "severity", "type", "score"])
from(bucket: "${bucket}") |> range(start: -20m) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "telemetry_raw" and r.variable == "TemperaturaEscape" and r._field == "value")

from(bucket: "${bucket}") |> range(start: -6h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "anomaly_event") |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value") |> keep(columns: ["_time", "equipment", "severity", "type", "message", "score"]) |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
